reason: Use Tier 2: untie input and output item embeddings to learn directional purchase relationships. Attention plus preference fusion reached 0.5237, while exponential pooling fell to 0.5000; these results do not support further recency tuning, and the reported broader plateau lacks detailed results. A remaining hypothesis is that shared embeddings constrain items to serve simultaneously as history features and prediction targets, limiting asymmetric next-purchase relationships, especially in Electronics.
